name: Sequoia Park Zoo Conservation Grants
summary: Annual conservation grants from the zoo's Conservation Council for research or conservation management projects, including habitat restoration, that benefit wildlife and habitats; pre-proposals come first, then invited full proposals.

calls.label: 2026-27 cycle pre-proposals

status.quote: As of November 2, 2026, we are no longer accepting 2026 conservation grant application preproposals.

calls.note: Full proposals by invitation, due early January 2027; next preproposal period expected in Fall 2027.

access.quote: Once reviewed and if accepted, applicants will be invited to submit a full proposal due in early January 2027.

window.quote: Our next open preproposal period will be in Fall 2027.
